name: Pension Scheme (HBOCWWB)
benefit: 1. Under this scheme, a registered construction worker is given a pension of ₹3,250/- per month after the age of 60 years.
_eligibility_text:
1. Applicants should be registered with the Haryana Building &amp; Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
   1. The registered worker must have a minimum of three years of regular membership before completing the age of 60 years.
   1. The registered worker should not be availing the pension benefits from any other Department/Board/Corporation of the Haryana Government.

**Note 01:** It is necessary to mention the payment of the registration fee and contribution on the identity card of the registered worker.
**Note 02:** At the time of registration, it is necessary to attach a copy of the document submitted regarding proof of age.
**Note 03:** It is necessary to attach the No Objection Certificate issued by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment.
**Note 04:** It is mandatory to submit/upload a life certificate every year in the month of November, otherwise, the board will be unable to give a pension.
